msg: Hello My name is [NOMBRE], i'd like to inquiry about the modalities for a 2 day dive package at the rosario islands. i'll be heading in on april 13th and 14th leaving on the 15th in the morning. What do i need to bring. i<ll be in Cartagena, is it hard to get to your location, any advice?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The Rosario Islands are a beautiful place for a two-day dive trip! Since you’ll be coming from Cartagena, there are two options:

- *4 daytime dives over 2 days:* USD 316 online / USD 351 regular, or COP 1,154,000 online / COP 1,282,000 regular. You’ll need to stay one night on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. Lunch is included on day 1 only.
- *5 dives over 2 days:* 4 daytime dives plus a night dive. USD 392 online / USD 436 regular, or COP 1,429,000 online / COP 1,587,000 regular. This also requires one night on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. Lunch is included on day 1 only.

Both options require diving certification. Bring your certification card, swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, and comfortable clothes. Diving equipment is included.

From Cartagena, meet at *Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.* The dock is about five minutes from the historic center, but there’s no hotel pick-up, so you’ll need to arrange your own transport there. The boat ride takes about an hour. The return to Cartagena is scheduled for 3:00 p.m. on the final day, arriving around 4:15 p.m., so leaving the islands on the morning of the 15th may not fit either package. You’ll also need to wait at least 18 hours after diving before flying.

You'll also need:
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
